title: Just Better
description: Just Better is a Vanilla+ modpack that keeps Minecraft fun in the way it was designed, but making it "Just Better." It does so by making the game run better, look better, and feel better while keeping the experience familiar.
body: ![Two teams, drenched in the beautiful light that is proton shaders, surrounded by the clear and defined setting due to the optimization and rendering mods installed.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d6edd32eed835d765c062f456f11fc18060e14e.png)**_Just Better_** is a _Vanilla+_ modpack that keeps Minecraft **fun in the way it was designed**, but making it "Just Better." It does so by making the game run better, look better, and feel better while keeping the experience familiar. For example, the pack includes a collection of performance mods that help increase FPS, reduce loading times, and improve overall stability. Whether you're playing on an older computer or just want a smoother experience, Minecraft should feel noticeably more responsive. There are also a variety of visual enhancements. Better animations, improved weather effects, connected textures, realistic sound physics, and shader support help make the world feel more immersive while remaining true to the original Minecraft feel. Furthermore, a number of quality-of-life mods are included as well, making everyday gameplay less monotonous. Inventory management, crafting, enchanting, information displays, and general usability have all been improved without becoming overwhelming or completely game changing. While there are a few server-side mods that fit into this quality of life category, there is a separate version, allowing for public server use due to it being completely client side. (Just Better: The Server Modpack) Other major additions include: Controller support, improved terrain generation, and multiplayer friendly components. **_Once you launch this modpack, you'll never want to turn back..._**
